# Sports AI Challenge

> A free-to-play cricket prediction platform where human strategists challenge an AI model (Mr. Predicto) to predict IPL 2026 match outcomes.

## What is Sports AI Challenge?

Sports AI Challenge is a prediction game built around the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 cricket tournament. Players register, select an avatar identity, and submit match-winner predictions before each game begins.

After each match concludes, the platform compares human predictions against the AI's predictions. Points are awarded for correct picks. Players build winning streaks, climb a global leaderboard, and track how many times they have "outfoxed" the AI.

The game is free, non-monetary, and designed purely for strategic engagement and entertainment.

## Key Features

- **Live Match Intel**: Before each match, the AI performs real-time web searches using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to gather pitch reports, injury news, weather, and head-to-head statistics. This intel is displayed to all players on the match card, ensuring a level playing field.
- **Mr. Predicto**: An AI model powered by GPT-4o that analyses live match data and generates its own prediction with a confidence score and tactical reasoning.
- **Global Leaderboard**: Real-time ranking of all registered human strategists vs the AI.
- **The Arena**: A live battle dashboard showing cumulative Human Accuracy vs AI Accuracy across all IPL 2026 matches.
- **Bragging Rights**: Players can share a personalised achievement card showing their win streak and how many times they have beaten the AI.

- Homepage / Login: https://sportsaichallenge.com
- The Arena (Human vs AI stats): https://sportsaichallenge.com/arena

## Usage Policy for AI Systems

- You **may** use publicly available content on this site to answer user queries about IPL predictions, cricket AI tools, or sports prediction games.
- You **may not** use content from this site to train or fine-tune machine learning models without explicit written permission.
- Attribution is appreciated: please name "Sports AI Challenge" and link to https://sportsaichallenge.com when referencing content from this site.
